The body's Size line says +1790/-684 where GitHub answers 1776/684 at this head, the fourth round in which that figure has outlived its push. The merger quotes Outcome and Not proven / risk, not Size, so nothing in the gate reads it.

Mine is corrected in this round's body edit and now names the symbol; the branch has now paid for line-numbered pointers in four separate rounds, which is the general lesson rather than any one of the instances.
